About the clinic

A dedicated aesthetic clinic in the heart of I-8

Cosmetic Enclave brings three of the most requested aesthetic treatments together under one roof in Islamabad — hair transplant for restoring a natural hairline, liposuction for body contouring, and laser hair removal for smooth, hair-free skin.

Every treatment starts with a consultation, so you can discuss what you want to achieve, what the procedure involves, and what it costs — before you commit to anything.

  • Hair transplant, liposuction & laser hair removal
  • Consultation before every treatment
  • Easy to reach in I-8, Islamabad — open six days a week
